instruction: Make all section headings in the document bold

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires making all section headings bold in the document. The document has multiple sections like 'Writing with Libre Office', 'Page Layout With Libre Office', etc. The evaluator detects section headings using the reliable heading style mechanism (para.style.name.startswith('Heading')) and checks if 100% are bold. Custom getter identifies section headings using Word's built-in heading styles and checks bold formatting (treating None as inherited bold), custom metric calculates the ratio and provides partial credit based on completion level.

scoring_breakdown.0.0-0.99: Not all section headings are bold (proportional score based on percentage)

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies section headings using Word's built-in heading styles (para.style.name.startswith('Heading')), which is the most reliable method for Word documents
Bold detection logic is correct: checks if all text runs satisfy 'run.bold is not False', properly handling inherited bold formatting (run.bold can be None when inherited from style)
Metric correctly calculates bold_ratio and compares against min_bold_ratio, providing proportional partial credit
Expected value min_bold_ratio=1.0 correctly matches the instruction semantic requirement of 'all section headings'
Complete coverage: evaluator checks ALL detected headings, fully verifying the instruction requirement
Postconfig properly saves the document (Ctrl+S) before verification, ensuring getter reads the updated state
